tasks.title: Audit existing CI status, broken checks and skipped suites
acceptance: Record current branch SHA and exact status of existing checks
Separate environmental gaps from code failures, no invented pass claims

tasks.title: Create repeatable two-tenant SQL seed and request matrix
acceptance: Two tenants with cross-linked IDs exercise each protected entity
Negative results prove no foreign mutation/disclosure
tasks.verification: SQL integration fixture and test report

tasks.title: Run HTTP tenant isolation regression across methods
acceptance: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE Owner A against B category/item/media denied
No response reveals B sensitive data

tasks.title: Test cookie/CSRF/logout/lockout/role matrix
acceptance: Missing CSRF, invalid cookie or revoked owner blocks write
Platform-only routes reject owner

tasks.title: Test published/unpublished visibility in raw SSR HTML
acceptance: Draft/deleted/suspended menu content absent from raw response
Statuses, canonical and noindex match contract

tasks.title: Verify printed QR redirect and malformed codes
acceptance: /m/{PublicCode} is one valid temporary redirect to current canonical
Invalid code safely rejected and no stale slug after rename

tasks.title: Run malformed and cross-tenant image tests
acceptance: Spoofed MIME, oversize and foreign IDs denied
Successful processed object strips metadata with stable dimensions

tasks.title: Run AR RTL/EN LTR and EGP bidi regression
acceptance: Correct lang/dir/price and Arabic fallback verified
No accidental mechanical fallback translations or clipped punctuation

tasks.title: Verify Restaurant/Café theme component parity
acceptance: Same components implement correct accent/buttons/chips/prices for both
Semantic availability/error color unchanged
tasks.verification: Unit snapshots + one family visual check

tasks.title: Run owner end-to-end categories, items, image, QR journeys
acceptance: Owner can complete actions or see honest errors only after API response
No direct foreign entity access in same journey

tasks.title: Run admin create, status, publication, audit journey
acceptance: Privileged API writes and status history reflect audit
Owner role cannot open/execute platform controls

tasks.title: Run complete Demo Restaurant/Café flow without persistence
acceptance: Steps preserve local input and distinguish Café/Restaurant previews
No tenant/account/QR backend write occurs

tasks.title: Check keyboard, contrast, focus, dialogs and touch targets
acceptance: WCAG 2.2 AA project criteria checked on representative screens
Visible actionable labels, no focus trap or clipped messages

tasks.title: Run width interpolation and no-horizontal-scroll browser QA
acceptance: 320/360/375/390/412/430/768/1024/1440 layouts tested where affected
No overlap, cut-off CTA or unexpected horizontal scroll

tasks.title: Verify canonical, metadata, sitemap, noindex and structured data
acceptance: Raw HTML and sitemap only show eligible published entities
Canonical, redirects and server statuses match source contract

tasks.title: Run controlled SSR and mobile performance baseline
acceptance: Document target region, fixture sizes, device profile and repeated CWV/LHCI
No claimed metric without actual run and artifact

tasks.title: Run stale RowVersion and publication/cache racing tests
acceptance: Stale edit gets 412 without overwrite and fresh public version consistent
Concurrent A/B reads never share private content

tasks.title: Run final traceability/FR acceptance review
acceptance: Every P0 FR and NFR has linked executed evidence or explicit blocker
Block GO if security/SSR/availability verification incomplete

tasks.title: Define atomic PR quality checks and required statuses
acceptance: Branch checks cover affected Angular/.NET/SQL/SSR tests
No automatic merge on unverified high/critical change
tasks.verification: CI workflow review and test run

tasks.title: Set issue status workflow and reviewer handoff contract
acceptance: BACKLOG/READY/IN_PROGRESS/IN_REVIEW/DONE/BLOCKED mapped to tracker
Closure requires merged PR + verified acceptance evidence, not just a comment

tasks.title: Document SSR host, TLS and proxy trust configuration
acceptance: Planned same-origin ingress, Node SSR and API services recorded
No open proxy identity spoofing or SSR-only CSR fallback

tasks.title: Provision isolated staging environment
acceptance: Staging SSL and same-origin paths work without production credentials
Test SQL/media populated only from safe synthetic fixtures

tasks.title: Run SQL backup and restore drill in isolated staging
acceptance: Backup restores schema, tenant constraints and representative data
Document RPO/RTO and exact restore commands

tasks.title: Run media object restore/reconciliation drill
acceptance: Safe object backups restore image references correctly
No orphaned media or leaked public write credentials

tasks.title: Configure redacted logs, correlation and health checks
acceptance: Errors traced without private tenant metadata
Readiness and alerts identify SQL/media/SSR failures

tasks.title: Add release smoke test checklist
acceptance: Smoke covers public QR/canonical, owner login, admin status and test tenant scope
Recovery and hidden-menu states included

tasks.title: Document staging deployment and rollback command path
acceptance: Deployment tied to immutable commit and reversibility documented
DB migration and media rollback risks explicitly reviewed

tasks.title: Run rollback tabletop and dependency failure rehearsal
acceptance: Simulated broken API/SSR/media shows safe degraded result
Rollback restores known good state without losing test data

tasks.title: Prepare final GO/NO-GO release evidence decision
acceptance: Block release on failed tenant/SSR/privacy or untested restore
Require explicit human approval; no autonomous deploy/merge
